```{r}
library(spatialss)
library(sf)
library(raster)
library(dplyr)
library(tmap)
library(ggplot2)
```

## 加载示例数据

```{r}
sichuan <- load_sichuan()
china_counties <- load_china("counties")
```

```{r fig.align='center', fig.height=5}
# 查看数据结构
head(sichuan)
```

## 空间子集操作

```{r}
# 按属性子集化
chengdu <- sichuan[sichuan$Region == "成都市", ]
chengdu
```

```{r}
# 加载世界数据
world <- load_world()
china <- load_china("province")
china
```

## 几何运算 - 质心与缓冲区

```{r fig.align='center', fig.height=5}
# 计算几何中心
sichuan_centroids <- st_centroid(sichuan)

tm_shape(sichuan) + tm_borders() +
  tm_shape(sichuan_centroids) + tm_dots(col = "red", size = 0.3) +
  tm_layout(title = "四川地级市几何中心")
```

```{r fig.align='center', fig.height=5}
# 缓冲区
chengdu_centroid <- st_centroid(chengdu)
chengdu_buffer <- st_buffer(chengdu_centroid, dist = 100000)

tm_shape(sichuan) + tm_borders(alpha = 0.5) +
  tm_shape(chengdu_buffer) + tm_borders(col = "red", lwd = 2) +
  tm_layout(title = "成都市100公里缓冲区")
```

## 空间连接

```{r fig.align='center', fig.height=5}
# 空间汇合
sichuan_union <- st_union(sichuan)

tm_shape(sichuan_union) + tm_borders(col = "blue", lwd = 2) +
  tm_layout(title = "四川省合并边界")
```

## 栅格数据运算

```{r}
# 加载四川夜间灯光
light_sc <- load_nightlights(crop_to = "sichuan")
light_sc
```

```{r fig.align='center', fig.height=5}
# 栅格子集化
plot(light_sc, main = "四川省夜间灯光")
```

## 栅格与矢量交互

```{r fig.align='center', fig.height=5}
# 提取每个地级市的平均夜间灯光
sichuan$mean_light <- raster::extract(light_sc, sichuan, fun = mean, na.rm = TRUE)

tm_shape(sichuan) +
  tm_fill(col = "mean_light",
          palette = "YlOrRd",
          title = "平均夜间灯光") +
  tm_borders() +
  tm_layout(title = "四川各地级市平均夜间灯光（2015）")
```
